title: Older voters happiest with election results, survey suggests
summary_full: Older people are more satisfied with the results of last month's 15th Saeima elections, according to a new survey. Younger voters are more sceptical about the outcome of this election, while residents aged 60 and over are the most satisfied, according to the survey carried out by the research agency Norstat which asked for the views of 1,001 people across Latvia, aged 18 to 74.
